jobs.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Director, New Product Development – Digital Assets & Stablecoin Payments

Overview

Mastercard Foundry is the innovation engine of Mastercard and a hub for new product development. We do this by driving product innovation in emerging technologies and interfaces while focusing on developing a point of view to enhance existing solutions and new use-cases. We also focus on building revenue generating ecosystems and flywheels that can be standalone in adjacent segments and markets. Examples of focus areas include Digital Assets/Stablecoins, Consumer value propositions, Digital payments, Payment Acceptance and Processing, and applications of Artificial Intelligence.

The Director, New Product Development will be a critical driver of product strategy across the Core Payments portfolio of new products at Mastercard. The role will focus on identification of new digital products, services and solutions that differentiate and grow Mastercard’s Core Payments business.

This role will lead new product development for digital assets / cryptocurrency and stablecoin capabilities, translating emerging blockchain technologies into scalable, compliant payment solutions across Mastercard’s network. The Director will partner closely with product, engineering, security, compliance, ecosystem partners and Foundry capabilities (R&D, CXD, Start Path, etc.) to design and deliver technically robust crypto/stablecoin products from concept through commercialization.

Responsibilities will include driving new product strategy, cross-portfolio narrative, and selective identification, testing and launch of new products and ventures that drive significant in year revenue and strategic differentiation for Mastercard.

Role

Lead new product development for digital assets / cryptocurrency and stablecoin capabilities, from early concept and prototyping through pilot, and launch across Mastercard’s network
Define and own the product vision / concepts and roadmap for crypto and stablecoin use cases
Partner closely with product, engineering, architecture, and security teams to design production‑grade, scalable blockchain‑based solutions that drive commercial value
Collaborate cross‑functionally with legal, compliance, risk, and franchise teams to ensure all crypto/stablecoin products are compliant with regulatory requirements and Mastercard rules frameworks
Translate emerging blockchain and stablecoin technologies into clear product requirements, technical tradeoffs, and executable delivery plans
Engage with external partners (e.g., VASPs, issuers, fintechs, infrastructure providers) to co‑develop and integrate crypto and stablecoin solutions into the Mastercard ecosystem
Drive experimentation through proofs‑of‑concept and market tests, incorporating learnings into product iterations and commercialization decisions
Build business cases and success metrics to demonstrate customer value, MA network impact, and commercial viability of crypto and stablecoin products
Serve as an internal subject‑matter expert on crypto, stablecoins, and digital asset infrastructure across Mastercard
Mentor and provide guidance to junior team members.

All About You

Passion for innovation and emerging technology
Strong problem solving, research, analytical and quantitative skills, with the ability to build business cases that articulate commercial value
Proven experience leading product development for cryptocurrency, stablecoin, or blockchain‑based solutions in a regulated financial services environment
Strong understanding of blockchain infrastructure, stablecoin models, wallets, settlement flows, and on/off‑ramp architectures, with the ability to translate concepts into scalable products
Demonstrated ability to partner effectively with engineering, security, legal, compliance, and risk teams to deliver compliant, production‑grade solutions
Track record of taking new products from concept to launch, including defining requirements, managing tradeoffs, and driving execution across cross‑functional teams
Strategic, outcome‑oriented leader with the ability to influence stakeholders, articulate a clear product/ concept vision, and operate effectively in ambiguous, fast‑evolving environments
Excellent presentation and communication skills, both drafting and presenting, oral and written
Prior consulting, banking or emerging payments experience a plus
Bachelor’s degree required, Advanced degree a plus

Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in the US, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive base salary and may be eligible for an annual bonus or commissions depending on the role. The base salary offered may vary depending on multiple factors, including but not limited to location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The ideal candidate combines deep technical knowledge, strong product execution skills, sound judgment, and exceptional attention to detail. Through a unified and fluid organization, Publicis Groupe partners with its clients across communication, media, data and technology to ensure access to the full breadth of capabilities in every market. Groupe Solutions is an accelerant at the center of the Groupe. Made up of audience strategists, data scientists, and analytics practitioners, Groupe Solutions will partner with Groupe leaders to win or retain strategic accounts and serve as business owners of Groupe’s AI Platforms.

Responsibilities

The ideal candidate combines deep product management expertise with strong fluency in data visualization, analytics, and reporting best practices. They understand how to work across organizational boundaries — partnering with engineering, data, media, and business intelligence teams globally — to build scalable reporting capabilities that unlock value for Groupe agencies and their clients.

Collaborate with engineering, data foundations, and platform architecture teams to build scalable, performant, and visually compelling analytics experiences.

Join and help grow a focused and performance-driven environment where data excellence fuels innovation in marketing and advertising AI.

5+ years of product management experience, with demonstrated ownership of building data visualization, reporting, or analytics products.
Direct experience designing or shipping dashboarding and reporting capabilities within a platform context — particularly products that surface media, advertising, or marketing performance data.
Background in the marketing technology (MarTech) or advertising technology (AdTech) space, with deep familiarity in areas such as media measurement, campaign analytics, attribution modeling, and audience insights.

Strong execution background with a record of shipping analytics or reporting products that serve multiple stakeholder groups across media, strategy, and client service functions.
Excellent cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across engineering, data, and business teams globally.

Experience building strong relationships across organizational boundaries, including the ability to collaborate effectively with external technology partners and navigate competing priorities.
A highly customer-centric mindset, with strong instincts for what makes an exceptional digital experience and a willingness to challenge existing approaches when there is a better way.

Portfolio strategy and vision: Define the multi-year vision and strategy for a portfolio of AI products and capabilities. Business discovery at scale: Partner with business-unit and enterprise leaders to map their operations end to end. Turn ambiguous, high-stakes problems into a slate of AI use cases, each with a clear business case, and sequence them into a portfolio.
Hands-on prototyping: Build working prototypes and demos with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex) to prove feasibility and value before a full team is committed. Stay close enough to the technology to make credible technical calls.
Requirements and scoping: Turn validated use cases into buildable requirements: user stories, acceptance criteria, edge cases, and success metrics. Shape the end-to-end user experience with design, because adoption depends on usability.
Delivery and execution: Drive the build from prototype to production across your portfolio. Sequence the work, make scope and tradeoff calls as models and constraints shift, unblock teams, and keep momentum from first demo through launch and iteration.
Evaluation and quality standards: Define how quality is measured. Build golden sets, error budgets, and eval frameworks; run offline and production evals; choose the right metrics (precision, recall, task success, hallucination rate); apply LLM-as-judge where it has been validated. Turn results into launch decisions and leadership readouts.
Solution architecture: Partner with engineering on high-level architecture and feasibility across the portfolio, while owning the context engineering and skill-creation components of the AI harness and setting the reusable patterns others build on.
Cross-organizational leadership: Lead engineers, data scientists, designers, product managers, and business partners without direct authority. Influence VP-level organizations through written narratives, business cases, and executive forums. Author the playbooks, skills, and solution patterns for building AI at Humana.
Governed delivery: Move solutions through Humana's enterprise AI governance (AIRB, LRC, Responsible AI Council), owning the product documentation, scorecards, and stage-gate reviews, and help shape the governance standards themselves as the portfolio grows.
Talent and standards: Raise the bar for the whole team. Mentor senior and lead product managers, contribute to hiring and promotion assessments, and set the craft standard for building with AI across the organization.

Communication across domains: You move fluently between business and technical concepts, with a track record of business cases, ROI models, and roadmaps that inform investment decisions at the executive level.

Portfolio strategy and vision: Define the multi-year vision and strategy for a portfolio of AI products and capabilities. Business discovery at scale: Partner with business-unit and enterprise leaders to map their operations end to end. Turn ambiguous, high-stakes problems into a slate of AI use cases, each with a clear business case, and sequence them into a portfolio.

Requirements and scoping: Turn validated use cases into buildable requirements: user stories, acceptance criteria, edge cases, and success metrics. Shape the end-to-end user experience with design, because adoption depends on usability.
Delivery and execution: Drive the build from prototype to production across your portfolio. Sequence the work, make scope and tradeoff calls as models and constraints shift, unblock teams, and keep momentum from first demo through launch and iteration.
Evaluation and quality standards: Define how quality is measured. Build golden sets, error budgets, and eval frameworks; run offline and production evals; choose the right metrics (precision, recall, task success, hallucination rate); apply LLM-as-judge where it has been validated. Turn results into launch decisions and leadership readouts.
Solution architecture: Partner with engineering on high-level architecture and feasibility across the portfolio, while owning the context engineering and skill-creation components of the AI harness and setting the reusable patterns others build on.
Cross-organizational leadership: Lead engineers, data scientists, designers, product managers, and business partners without direct authority. Influence VP-level organizations through written narratives, business cases, and executive forums. Author the playbooks, skills, and solution patterns for building AI at Humana.
Governed delivery: Move solutions through Humana's enterprise AI governance (AIRB, LRC, Responsible AI Council), owning the product documentation, scorecards, and stage-gate reviews, and help shape the governance standards themselves as the portfolio grows.
Talent and standards: Raise the bar for the whole team. Mentor senior and lead product managers, contribute to hiring and promotion assessments, and set the craft standard for building with AI across the organization.
Communication and influence: Communicate strategy, roadmap, requirements, ROI, and eval results clearly to executive, business, and technical audiences, and represent Humana's AI product work externally with partners, vendors, and the broader community.
Staying current: Track advances in models, agents, evals, and emerging techniques (agent harness, loop, and graph / GraphRAG approaches), form a defensible point of view on where they are headed, and apply them across your portfolio.

Required Qualifications

Use your skills to make an impact

10+ years of product or related experience, with AI/ML or GenAI products shipped to production. Candidates with fewer years but a strong engineering background and real fluency in AI will be considered.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading.

About The Role

Socure’s rapid growth requires investment in a sophisticated launch process - one that keeps up with increasing volume, while making sure that we are continually raising the bar and working from the same page across the organization.

You will build and lead a small Launch Operations team that maintains clear visibility across upcoming product launches, and keeps cross-functional teams aligned leveraging the Product Manager (PM) owned launch checklist. For a start you will be the senior IC in this role as you prove value (see what success looks like below) for the rest of the team to be staffed. For the start you will need to prioritize the most essential elements to track and report on. So PMs will continue to quarterback product strategy, narrative, and customer readiness, while you (and eventually your team) provide the operational backbone to keep major milestones on track on the launch checklist.

Launches rarely fall behind because people don't know what to do; they slip because no single person owns making sure deliverables happen on time and with a clear backup plan. Your team will step in as that standing owner - not doing the launch deliverables yourselves, but guaranteeing everything is clearly assigned, dated, visible, and moving forward.

Sitting within Product Strategy & Operations, you'll collaborate closely with Product Marketing, Legal, RevOps, Engineering and other teams to make execution seamless and help product launches become world class

What You'll Do

Run the weekly launch accountability forum

Set up and run a weekly launch check-in using a leaderboard developed and driven with our Product Manager input tool
Serve as the driving force in the room—spotting risks early, testing resolution plans, and keeping work moving forward without taking on the task execution yourself.
Maintain a consistent accountability cadence across all launch sizes—from major PR and investor launches to smaller feature updates and multi-tier strategic initiatives.

Own the launch checklist and ownership model to drive Product org accountabilities

Shift the launch checklist away from PMs managing every detail to direct task ownership by functional leads (e.g., Legal handles legal approvals, PMM leads product naming, Revenue Operations manages SKU setups).
Work with teammates in Product Operations to refine the checklist over time, adding or removing items as needs evolve and distinguishing true systemic gaps from one-off issues.
Share clear updates and digests with partner groups (PMM, Legal, Engineering, Support, RevOps) so open items stay top of mind naturally.
Keep teams aligned on execution discipline: if an item isn't assigned, dated, and visible, it isn't ready for launch.

Turn systems into launch visibility

Pull target launch dates directly from roadmap tools like Aha! or Jira instead of relying on manually updated spreadsheets.
Establish clear criteria for when a feature enters the launch checklist process (typically 6–12 weeks before launch) and guide the initial workflow.
Adapt alongside Product Operations systems and tools as we automate tracking views and mature our operational system.

What Success Looks Like

Executive leadership can understand the accurate status for any upcoming launch without needing to ask around for manual updates.
Every item on the launch checklist is owned directly by someone in the functional team doing the work. Your team will own raising awareness and visibility early and upfront
At-risk items get a clear recovery plan right away, and blockers are resolved or escalated
Our launch cadence scales smoothly across major releases and new capabilities for a start; and a potential for the team to partner with other functions like Technical Project Management teams for complex multi-team initiatives.
Commercial and field teams have timely, dependable visibility into launch timelines and feature availability, ideally with a rolling 90 day window view out
Prove the value first as the leading senior IC, and eventually build and lead a team that focuses on tracking launch health across key strategic initiatives, working directly with owning teams, and keeping status updates accurate.

What You Bring

15+ years of experience in Product Operations, Program Management, or cross-functional tech operations inside product or engineering teams.
Proven experience running effective accountability rhythms (recurring reviews, status dashboards, operating cadence) that build trust and drive results through influence

Job Description

The Server Product Manager owns the definition, delivery, and lifecycle performance of complex server products or product line elements. The role is accountable for making high‑quality product decisions, ensuring strong cross-functional execution, and maintaining product competitiveness throughout the lifecycle.

This role operates as the primary integrator across engineering, operations, sales, and marketing, translating requirements into clear direction, aligning stakeholders, and driving execution with consistency and predictability. The Product Manager applies deep domain expertise to improve decision outcomes, product quality, and business performance within their scope. You will be expected to own one or more server products as well as supporting sustaining activities on existing products.

Key Responsibilities

Product Definition and Decision Ownership

Define product requirements, configurations, and positioning within assigned scope
Develop clear, well-founded recommendations with explicit trade-offs across cost, performance, and timing
Drive alignment on product decisions across stakeholders and ensure consistent understanding and execution
Anticipate dependencies and downstream impacts to minimise rework and late-stage changes

Lifecycle Management and Execution

Own the product lifecycle from concept through launch, in-market management, and transition
Ensure product readiness across all dimensions, including supply, quality, pricing, and sales enablement
Maintain predictable execution cadence, proactively addressing risks and resolving issues
Support lifecycle transitions, replacements, and substitutions while ensuring continuity for customers and sales

Cross-Functional Leadership

Lead coordination across engineering, supply chain, operations, sales, and marketing teams
Align priorities, timelines, and deliverables across multiple stakeholders and regions
Resolve conflicts and remove execution barriers to maintain progress and delivery quality
Establish clear accountability and ownership across all aspects of product execution

Product Competitiveness and Performance

Ensure products meet competitive benchmarks across performance, cost, feature set, and customer value
Monitor product performance in market and drive improvements where required
Support pricing, positioning, and configuration decisions in collaboration with commercial teams
Identify opportunities to improve product offering or address competitive gaps

Data, Tools, and Operational Discipline

Maintain accuracy and consistency of product data, configuration tools, and supporting collateral
Ensure stakeholders have access to reliable, up-to-date information for decision-making and execution
Establish and uphold standards that improve data quality and reduce operational errors
Resolve inconsistencies across teams, regions, or systems to maintain a single source of truth

Customer and Market Engagement

Develop strong understanding of customer requirements and usage scenarios across target segments
Incorporate customer and partner feedback into product definition and ongoing improvements
Engage with key stakeholders to validate product direction and support business development activities

Expertise and Continuous Improvement

Act as a recognized subject-matter expert within assigned product scope
Track relevant industry trends, technology developments, and partner roadmaps
Apply expertise to improve product decisions, resolve complex issues, and guide stakeholders
Share knowledge and contribute to the development of team capability and best practices

Technical AI Fluency

Comfortable working closely with engineering and technical teams without needing to specialize in implementation
Curious and open to continuous learning across technologies, tools, and evolving product domains
Interest in leveraging AI-assisted tools to improve effectiveness, insight, and decision quality
Awareness of AI-related considerations (e.g. security, data handling, product design implications) is advantageous

Leadership and Impact

Influences outcomes across functions through expertise, clarity of thinking, and delivery ownership
Drives alignment and accountability in complex, matrixed environments
Ensures decisions are understood, executed consistently, and deliver intended business outcomes
Contributes to a high-performing, collaborative, and effective team environment

Basic Qualifications

12+ years experience in server, infrastructure, or related product management roles
Proven track record of delivering complex products or product lines

Preferred Qualifications

Strong understanding of system-level design considerations and cost/performance trade-offs
Experience working across global, cross-functional organizations
Demonstrated ability to manage ambiguity and drive decisions to closure

new_jobs.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

Job Description Summary:

The Senior Director of Product Management will lead the product management team for Vertica, drawing on extensive experience, best practices, and a deep understanding of the market. They will be responsible for leading and owning the overall product vision roadmap and leading the individuals on their team to drive the roadmaps for each area. The ideal candidate brings significant experience in enterprise data and analytics platforms, including modern data warehouse and lakehouse architectures, analytical databases, cloud-native data platforms, and AI-driven analytics solutions.

Within the business unit, the role of product management will include identifying market opportunities, creating roadmaps, prioritizing features, validating engineering timelines and driving commercial success. In addition, this leader will define and institutionalize a modern product operating model that leverages design-led product management practices, customer discovery, user-centered design, product analytics, outcome-based prioritization, and continuous validation of customer and market needs. Establishing this role, both as a key component of Rocket leadership as well as a functional competency within the business unit, requires a seasoned professional with years of experience product managing technology solutions geared at the enterprise market.

To be successful in this role, this person will operate cross-functionally, engaging actively with their engineering counterparts as well as marketing, sales, GTM strategy, and customer success leadership. Building alignment around the business unit’s product direction throughout the company will be critical to driving growth in revenue, customer satisfaction, and market position. The Senior Director will partner closely with UX, architecture, engineering, and customer-facing teams to ensure product investments are informed by deep customer understanding, validated user workflows, and measurable business outcomes. They will also act as a public face of the business unit to analysts, customers, and partners, communicating the benefits of the solutions, the roadmap, and Rocket’s core values outside the organization. This individual will be expected to represent Rocket Software and Vertica as a thought leader in the data analytics, lakehouse, and data platform market, helping shape conversations around modern data architectures, performance, governance, and AI-enabled analytics.

The successful candidate combines strategic vision with operational excellence, demonstrating expertise in product operations, portfolio planning, customer-centric innovation, and data-informed decision making. They have a proven track record of leading teams through complex platform transformations, balancing near-term market opportunities with long-term architectural investments, and delivering measurable business outcomes in highly competitive enterprise software markets. As a leader, they develop high-performing teams, foster a culture of customer obsession and continuous learning, and inspire organizations to execute against ambitious product strategies.

:

Understand the functional role of product management and how to build and implement a product management function within an organization
Understand customer pains and domain landscape in your product portfolio to be an advocate for addressing those customer and partner needs. This includes anticipating future customer needs.

Interact with customers and partners to build relationships and gain perspective on how product features are used
Frame market segmentation and targeting in order to define market opportunities for the overall product portfolio

Oversee and provide direction for the creation and socialization of product-level documents
Engage Product Marketing in the process for creating product positioning, value propositions and messaging that resonates with the buying audience
Support corporate development activities in identifying new inorganic options and integrating acquisitions
Lead competitive and win/loss analysis. Support analyst relations by acting as a spokesperson for the business unit solutions
Support enablement efforts for sales and channel partners
Serve as a market-facing subject matter expert for your product portfolio

Expertise with product management of B2B applications
Excellent written, verbal and presentation skills
Ability to partner with cross-functional teams, including R&D, Sales, Business Development/Pricing, and Marketing
Plan, execute, and lead successful product releases
Strategic thinker, creative problem solver and strong analytical skills
Influencing and communicating product offers to customers, prospects, sales, industry analysts and trade press
Minimum 15 years of related product or business experience with enterprise data, analytics, AI, machine learning, database, or cloud data platform products
Experience with project management approaches, including discovery, scoping, planning, and leading project reviews among business partners and stakeholders
Experience with a rapidly scaling technology/software business
Experience in team/people management or functional leadership roles

Experience with modern data ecosystems including Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, Spark, Kafka, Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
